insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited

great.name: NCB
great.quote: “On Renewal of this Policy with the Company without a break, a sum equal to 10% of the Base Sum Insured of the expiring Policy shall be provided as multiplier benefit irrespective of any claims... The maximum multiplier bonus will not exceed 100% of the Basic Sum Insured in any Policy Year.”
great.explanation: Your Sum Insured increases by 10% each year on renewal without breaks, even if you make claims, up to 100% of the base Sum Insured. This means your coverage grows over time regardless of claims, which is better than typical no-claim bonuses that reset after claims.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: “30-day waiting period... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident”
good.explanation: Illness claims are excluded for the first 30 days except for accidents. This is standard practice in health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.”
good.explanation: Certain listed conditions and surgeries have a 24-month waiting period before coverage starts. This matches the industry standard.

good.name: PED Waiting
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage, which is acceptable and common in the market.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization
good.quote: “Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... incurred upto 60 days before the date of admission to the Hospital”
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered, which is standard.

good.name: Post-hospitalization
good.quote: “Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... incurred upto 90 days after discharge from Hospitalisation”
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 90 days after hospital discharge are covered, which meets market norms.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: No restore/reinstatement benefit wording found in the provided document text.
bad.reference: Not mentioned in provided pages (Policy Wording extract)
bad.explanation: Sum Insured is not replenished after a claim, so you cannot restore your coverage once used.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “Annexure I - List I - Items for which coverage is not available in the policy... GLOVES... MASK... NEBULISATION KIT... ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]”
bad.explanation: Many consumables like gloves, masks, and various kits are excluded, so you must pay for these out-of-pocket.

bad.reference: Not mentioned in provided pages (Policy Wording extract)
